options.name: Preorders / waitlist deposits
options.description: Presell about 633 units at the target price $96.12 (net of ~3.5% card fees) to cover the $58,678 total cash need; refunds if the golden sample slips.

cost.label: estimate
cost.source_or_assumption: Assumed card-processing fee ~3.5% of preorder value; check your payment provider

pros: Preorder cash lands before the production deposit
cons: Delivery promise creates refund and legal exposure
Needs an audience: 633 buyers ≈ 32% of the 2,000-unit first order

options.name: Crowdfunding campaign
options.description: Reward-based campaign with a goal around $63,800 so that ~8% platform + processing fees still leave $58,678.

cost.label: estimate
cost.source_or_assumption: Assumed 5% platform fee + ~3% payment processing; verify on the chosen platform

cons: Fulfilment obligations start before mass production is proven

options.name: Inventory / purchase-order financing
options.description: Lender advances the ~$26,000 first production order against confirmed POs or preorders; repaid from sales.

cost.label: estimate
cost.source_or_assumption: Assumed 12-20% annualised cost; quotes vary widely

cons: Needs revenue history or confirmed POs
Does not cover tooling or certification
Personal guarantees are common for first-time founders

options.name: Revenue-based financing
options.description: Advance repaid as a fixed share of monthly revenue until a cap; better for the second production run than the first.

cost.label: estimate
cost.source_or_assumption: Assumed flat fee 6-12% of the advance

options.name: Angel / pre-seed round
options.description: Raise about $77,000 (total cash + 30% buffer for slips and re-tooling).
cons: Slow to close for pre-revenue hardware

options.name: Negotiate factory terms
options.description: Ask for tooling amortised into the unit price (mold cost spread over the first orders) and 30/70 payment terms instead of 50/50; each step lowers the cash needed up front.

cost.label: estimate
cost.source_or_assumption: Trade-off: a higher unit price in exchange for less upfront cash

cons: Factory lock-in until the mold is paid

reconciliation_note: Differs from stage 5 by $+664 ($58,678 vs $58,014) because the negotiated quote qt_orchid_v2 replaced the estimate: FOB $13.00 vs $12.50 × 2,000, tooling $9,400 vs $10,100, payment terms 30% deposit / 70% before shipment
